findings.title: Commit message contains prohibited Co-authored-by attribution
findings.description: CLAUDE.md §Git Identity specifies: 'Never add Co-Authored-By or any Claude Code / Cursor attribution trailers'. The commit message ends with 'Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>', which violates this rule. Only 'Assisted-By: Claude <model> <noreply@anthropic.com>' and 'Signed-off-by: Daniel Sionov <kingddd301@gmail.com>' are allowed.

evidence.rule_citation: CLAUDE.md lines 1-14: 'Never add Co-Authored-By or any Claude Code / Cursor attribution trailers'

findings.recommendation: Amend the commit to remove the 'Co-authored-by: Cursor' trailer. Only include 'Assisted-By: Claude opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>' and 'Signed-off-by: Daniel Sionov <kingddd301@gmail.com>'.

findings.title: Commit prefix follows conventional format
findings.description: The commit message uses 'fix:' prefix, which correctly follows CLAUDE.md §Commit Format (Conventional Commits) requirements and will trigger a patch bump (1.0.X) as intended for this bug fix.

evidence.rule_citation: CLAUDE.md lines 16-24: 'PR titles and commit messages MUST use conventional commit prefixes. fix: → patch bump (1.0.X)'

findings.recommendation: No action required. The commit prefix is correct.

notes: Commit correctly uses 'fix:' prefix for conventional commits
